'''Serjay Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Viktus]] and the first member of [[House of Thul]] to survive the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He after advice of [[Moff]] [[Sarek]] charged an unidentified Sith Imperial to ally with [[Chanya Medaal]] of [[Order of Extermination]] to eliminate the threat of [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Soros|Black Hive]].<ref name="TOR" />
